Revenue from operations saw an upward trend, increasing by 18 percent year-on-year to Rs 952.99 crore. However, total expenses surged by 22 percent, totaling Rs 976.37 crore. articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India has eased foreign exchange reporting rules for services exports and imports, reducing compliance requirements for resident individuals and setting a ₹1 million threshold for certain transactions. The Business Correspondent segment also achieved a Gross Transaction Value of over Rs 41,400 crore.

articles.title: US Treasury projects $618 billion borrowing in Q4, $800 billion in Q1 2027
articles.desc: The US Treasury is estimating federal borrowing will hit $618 billion in the last quarter of 2026, which is $10 billion less than previously thought. Despite anticipating lower cash flows, the Treasury projects borrowing of $800 billion in early 2027 as well. Market watchers are eager for upcoming announcements regarding Treasury auctions, as these might indicate changes in their bond issuance tactics.

articles.title: India has never allowed genetically modified products' import, won't do in future: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India continues to maintain a strict policy against the import of genetically modified products, as stated by Minister Piyush Goyal. He highlighted that the dairy sector remains particularly sensitive and has not been opened in trade agreements. Goyal emphasized India's commitment to protecting its agricultural and fisheries sectors while seeking preferential market access for textiles and pharmaceuticals.

The nine-year project will strengthen indigenous defence manufacturing, enhance maritime capabilities and reinforce GRSE's warship-building position, adding significantly to its order book and long-term business prospects.

As economic conditions evolve, the demand for state-debt auctions remains a key focus, with investors showing caution amid global uncertainties.

articles.title: Angel One, CDSL, BSE, other capital market stocks jump up to 8%. 3 reasons behind the rally

articles.title: India to make tunnel boring machines at home if China curbs exports: Piyush Goyal

This statement came from Piyush Goyal, India's trade minister, after Beijing made its recent announcement. It highlights India’s plan to not rely on foreign supplies and enhance its domestic manufacturing capabilities in this crucial area.

articles.title: Saudi Aramco Q3 profit jumps 34.5% to $36.25 billion despite ongoing US-Iran conflict

articles.desc: Indian farmers face challenges in sowing winter crops amid dwindling water supplies from a weak monsoon. Amarsingh Gushinge's village experiences a significant rainfall deficit, impacting crop planting decisions. Food inflation could worsen as key staples see rising prices, aggravating the economic strain on households. The Reserve Bank of India may respond with interest rate hikes to combat rising inflationary pressures.

articles.title: Uncertainty is certain: India is resilient and will emerge stronger
articles.desc: Despite global uncertainty, India remains well placed to weather economic and market disruptions, supported by resilient growth, deeper domestic capital markets and rising private investment. Stronger institutions, infrastructure spending and emerging industries could further reinforce the country’s long-term prospects.

articles.title: US tech giants' AI borrowing could push up Europe's bond yields
articles.desc: Rising AI infrastructure investments are driving US technology giants to tap European bond markets, potentially increasing borrowing costs. Alphabet, Meta, Amazon and Microsoft are expected to boost debt issuance, intensifying competition for investor capital and putting pressure on corporate credit spreads and European government bond yields.

articles.title: China to expand global access to yuan assets, promote Hong Kong as offshore hub

articles.title: US midterm elections today: Can Trump’s pain be Dalal Street’s gain? Analysts estimate impact in 3 possible scenarios

This includes primarily the impact of higher memory costs, as well as some costs related to the ramp of Siri AI," Parekh said.

articles.title: Govt consults seed, fertiliser firms on easing regulatory hurdles
articles.desc: The Indian government is engaging with agricultural companies to address regulatory challenges that affect the sector. Consultations focus on updating the Seeds Act, 1966, to align with modern agricultural technology. Industry representatives have pointed out delays in approvals and licensing processes that hinder market access.

articles.title: Manufacturing activity eases in Oct as new order growth drops
articles.desc: Manufacturing activity in India experienced a slowdown in October, decreasing from the previous month's growth. Despite this, the sector remained above its long-run average due to stronger international demand. A survey indicated that nearly 18% of manufacturers anticipated increased output over the next year, supported by fresh client inquiries.

articles.title: Budget 2027: Customs duty relief on 118 goods under review
articles.desc: The Indian government is currently reviewing customs duty concessions applicable to 118 products set to expire. This review involves input from respective line ministries and industry stakeholders regarding these exemptions. Goods under review include materials for power projects and certain medical devices. A focus is on correcting the inverted duty structure to support local manufacturing initiatives. The outcomes of this review will influence the upcoming budget for 2027-28.

articles.title: VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules set 15-day deadline
articles.desc: The rules establish a multi-tier grievance redressal mechanism at the gram panchayat, block and district levels. Designated grievance redressal officers will be responsible for receiving, registering, inquiring into and disposing of complaints. Inquiries must be completed within seven working days.

articles.title: Govt set to tweak MSP norms for periodic price hikes of minor forest products
articles.desc: The Centre is planning to restructure the minimum support price mechanism for minor forest produce. This change aims to provide periodic hikes to benefit tribal communities relying on forest produce. TERI has been tasked to study the current MSP framework and assess potential rationalization. Concerns regarding stagnant MSP rates sparking exploitation among forest-dependent communities have been raised in parliamentary discussions.

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.desc: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

articles.title: Centre's FY27 fiscal deficit may exceed Budget target by Rs 1.2 lakh crore: SBI Research
articles.desc: India's central government anticipates a fiscal deficit exceeding budget estimates by Rs 1.2 lakh crore in 2026-27. This increase is primarily attributed to rising fertiliser, LPG, and petroleum subsidy expenses. Strong GST growth and disinvestment receipts may not offset the expected higher deficit. In addition, SBI Research recommends a revised long-term capital gains structure to generate additional revenue.
